title: Analysis manifest (.codebase-intelligence/manifest.json)
description: Written by scripts/file_fingerprints.py save. Lets a later session decide (1) whether a saved model belongs to this repository, (2) which files changed since, and (3) how much of the repository the earlier analysis covered. The manifest is a cache index, never proof of current behaviour.

model_version.description: A saved model with a version this tool does not understand must be rebuilt, not reused.

root_commits.description: Root commit hashes; stable across clones and the strongest identity signal.

analyzer_versions.description: A changed analyzer version invalidates edges that analyzer produced.

fingerprints.description: Repository-relative path to content fingerprint. Files that commonly hold secrets are never fingerprinted.

notes.description: Human statements of what the analysis did NOT cover (e.g. 'read only src/api and src/auth').

artifacts.description: Other files stored beside the manifest (overview.md, architecture.md, ...).
